meta_title: Ocean Vibe Dental | Implants and clear aligners in Fort Myers, FL
meta_desc: General dentistry, implants and clear aligners in Fort Myers, FL, with bilingual care and CBCT implant planning from Dr. Alexandra Zabala.
hero_h1: General, implant and aligner care in Fort Myers
hero_sub: A new Fort Myers practice owned and run by Dr. Alexandra Zabala, with bilingual care.
about_heading: A new practice, run by the dentist who owns it
about_body:
Ocean Vibe Dental opened in Fort Myers under Dr. Alexandra Zabala, who owns the practice and treats the patients herself. Care covers general dentistry, implants and clear aligners.

Implant cases are planned from a CBCT scan before treatment starts, and the practice is bilingual, so you can talk through the options in the language you are most comfortable in.

services.name: General dentistry
services.blurb: Everyday care for new and returning patients, with the same dentist each visit.

services.name: Dental implants
services.blurb: Missing teeth replaced with implants, placed to a plan made before treatment begins.

services.name: Clear aligners
services.blurb: Straightening treatment using removable clear aligners rather than fixed braces.

services.name: CBCT implant planning
services.blurb: Scan-based planning, so where an implant goes is decided before the day of surgery.

footer_tagline: Bilingual general, implant and aligner dentistry in Fort Myers.
why_this_angle: Played the new practice launch, bilingual care and CBCT implant planning from growth_trigger and role as the whole story, because an owner-run first-year practice is the one thing a chain in Fort Myers cannot claim.
